sections.title: Intended use
body: Research prototype to study accuracy loss at unseen hospitals and uncertainty-based review flags.
Not a medical device, not for diagnosis or treatment decisions. The flag is advisory.
Does not estimate tumor grade or stage.

body.Base: nnU-Net v2 (2.8.1), region-based (WT, TC, ET), configuration 3d_fullres
body.Training budget: 10 epochs, seed 12345 + fold index, 1 seed replicates per fold
body.Uncertainty: binary entropy of the member-mean sigmoid; members = seed replicates x flip TTA
body.Case score: mean uncertainty in a 3-voxel band around the predicted whole tumor
body.Trust gate: flag = score > review limit (NaN -> flag); limit chosen on in-site validation by rule {'method': 'quantile', 'q': 0.8}
body.Failure definition: WT or ET Dice < 0.7 (fixed before held-out evaluation)
body.Trained: yes: baseline only, site-held-out fold(s) listed under Per-group results (docs/deviations.md D15-D17)

body.Training data: FeTS 2022: 1,251 labeled cases from 23 institutions, partitioning_1.csv for sites
body.Unlabeled: 219 FeTS 2022 validation cases, used for the interface (EXAMPLE outlines unless predicted)

sections.title: Per-group results
body: baseline / mid / WT: in-site Dice 0.853 (n = 15), held-out Dice 0.849 (n = 15), gap 0.004 [95% CI -0.111, 0.111]
baseline / mid / TC: in-site Dice 0.823 (n = 15), held-out Dice 0.787 (n = 15), gap 0.035 [95% CI -0.135, 0.195]
baseline / mid / ET: in-site Dice 0.800 (n = 15), held-out Dice 0.763 (n = 15), gap 0.037 [95% CI -0.108, 0.202]
baseline / mid: failure detection (held-out) AUROC 0.89 [0.69, 1.00], 3 of 15 cases failed; review limit 0.173 flags 27%; failure rate flagged 50% vs unflagged 9%
Pilot result: 15 cases per split (docs/deviations.md D15-D17); confidence intervals are wide.

sections.title: Limitations
body: Laptop pilot: 10 epochs, one held-out site group, 15 test cases per split; other methods and folds not run.
Site is only a proxy for scanner and protocol; grade and site are confounded for the LGG-only group.
Five site groups give very low power for shift-versus-gap correlations.
Entropy-based uncertainty can be confidently wrong under strong shift; AUROC must be checked per site.
nnU-Net training is seeded but not bit-exact.

sections.title: Disclaimer
sections.body: Research prototype only. Not a medical device and not for diagnosis. Trust flags are advisory and depend only on an uncertainty score and a review limit.
